prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ moveRobot }`.

`moveRobot(grid, position, command)` moves a robot by at most one cell. `grid` must be a non-empty rectangular array of non-empty arrays. Each cell must be exactly `0` for open or `1` for blocked. `position` must be a plain object with integer `row` and `column` identifying an open cell. `command` must be exactly one of `N`, `S`, `E`, or `W`.

A command proposes movement north, south, east, or west. If the destination is outside the grid or blocked, return a new position equal in value to the original. Otherwise return the destination. The result must contain exactly `{ row, column }`.

Throw `TypeError` for malformed or ragged grids, invalid cell values, malformed positions, blocked or out-of-range starting positions, and unknown commands. Validate the entire grid, even when movement would not inspect every cell. Do not mutate the grid, its rows, or the position, and never return the original position object. Use only the JavaScript standard library.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
